note: Zoutleeuw third wall (from 1552, taking in the second wall of c. 1300) with five gates, repaired and given half-moons and hornworks from 1642; traced from the Ferraris map (1777). The citadel south of the town dates from 1670-79 and is NOT included.
source: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Zoutleeuw' (https://id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140044)

gateSources.Sint-Truidensepoort: inventory 140044 (barbican from 1642); Ferraris 'Porte de St Tron'
gateSources.Westpoort: unlabelled/illegible Ferraris gate on the west side; name is a placeholder
